transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get started on finalizing the interview panel for the vacant team-lead role. As you all know, Mara and Jonah are our two internal finalists, and I have authority to appoint the panel and approve the assessment process. We need to select three panelists from the available pool: Elliot, Rina, Sofia, and Tariq. Before I make that decision, I'd like to follow our routine process and ask for any relevant process or relationship considerations from the hiring manager, a peer manager, HR, and our employee representative. I also want to make sure we're upholding our accessibility practices — if either candidate has stated accessibility needs, those need to be implemented once raised through the employee representative, and we need to ensure both finalists have equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the leadership criteria even if interview formats differ. So please, go ahead and share anything relevant you think I should know before I finalize the panel and the assessment plan.
